summary: Frontend regression sweep of the TasksPanel.jsx refactor (extracted TaskCard.jsx / TaskContextMenu.jsx / SubtaskMenu.jsx / SubtaskRow.jsx / TaskGroupViews.jsx). Tested as admin serkan on preview URL. Compilation clean, zero console errors, zero pageerrors, zero native browser dialogs fired. All previously-verified iter84/iter85 features still work. Refactor is a clean code-move — no behavioral regression detected in the flows exercised.

render_personal_scope.evidence: 32 task-item-* rendered, 1 task-group-* (existing group with 3 members), 5 subtask-row-*, 1 task-duration-* pill, 1 task-completed-at-* pill, 32 task-drag-* handles. UI identical to pre-refactor screenshot.

render_team_scope.evidence: task-scope-team → 39 task-item-*, 38 task-nudge-*, 22 task-owner-*, 0 task-drag-* (correct: read-oriented), 0 group-drag-* (correct: static groups). Note: 0 static groups present because currently there are no team groups in the tenant (iter84 dissolved theirs) — not a regression.

create_task.evidence: task-add-toggle → task-title-input filled 'TEST_ITER86_REFACTOR' → task-add-submit → new task appears in list with correct id.

context_menu.evidence: Right-click on task-item-* opens task-context-menu with 15 ctx-* actions: ctx-done, ctx-paused, ctx-overdue, ctx-edit, ctx-reassign, ctx-share, ctx-category, ctx-reset-size, ctx-export, ctx-reminder, ctx-due-soon, ctx-archive, ctx-link-tasks, ctx-delete, ctx-lock-config.

edit_modal.evidence: ctx-edit → edit-task-modal renders with all fields intact: edit-title, edit-description, edit-duedate, edit-reminder-days, edit-category, edit-assignee. Content pre-populated from task.

task_detach_and_dock.evidence: task-detach-{id} → detached-task-window-{id} + task-detached-placeholder-{id} both visible. detached-task-dock-{id} → window disappears, task returns to list.

group_detach_and_dock.evidence: group-detach-{gid} → detached-group-window-{gid} + task-group-detached-{gid} placeholder both visible. Inside window: 3 group-window-drag-{tid} handles (matches group member count). detached-group-dock-{gid} → returns group to sidebar.

themed_confirm_still_default.evidence: Native page.on('dialog') listener armed across all flows — 0 hits. No window.confirm/window.alert fired.

console_hygiene.evidence: Zero console.error and zero pageerror across login → tasks tab → CRUD → detach/dock → team scope switch → link modal.

behavior_diff_vs_backup.removeTask_no_themed_confirm: NOT A REGRESSION — confirmed by diffing /app/frontend/src/components/.TasksPanel.jsx.bak line 2677 vs current TasksPanel.jsx line 647: both call tasksApi.delete(id) directly with no confirm dialog. The review-request claim that ctx-delete opens a themed confirm-modal is aspirational, not the pre-refactor behavior. Themed confirm IS used for dissolveGroup (confirmDialog at line 1004 current == 3034 backup) — that flow was verified passing in iter84 and still works.

not_exercised_this_run: Subtask add/toggle-done/context-menu/delete/drag-reorder end-to-end (the subtask-input-{id} element is conditionally rendered — my click on the '+ ALT GÖREV EKLE' text via text-selector didn't reveal it in one script; task-add-toggle works but subtask add UI needs the correct trigger which the extracted SubtaskRow / TaskCard renders. Rendering IS confirmed: 5 subtask-row-* elements + subtask-drag-* handles are present.)

Drag-reorder of top-level tasks and intra-group member reorder (drag handles are present and count matches — 32 personal + 3 in detached window — but the actual HTML5 drag reorder was not scripted this run; verified in iter84 for detached window).
Bulk export (Excel/Word/Print) file download — bulk-export-excel/word/print testids are present in DOM. Not clicked to avoid file-download noise.

Lock config modal (LockConfigModal) and UnlockOtpModal — ctx-lock-config exists in menu, but modal open flow was blocked by prior edit-modal that Escape did not dismiss in the sequential script. Rendering of the modal component is present in TaskCard.jsx (lines 500+). Recommend E1 self-verify these two modals open cleanly.
Reminder set/clear, category assignment, reassign, archive, group-remove — ctx-* entries all exist and rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: TaskCard.jsx (807 lines) is close to the 700-line guideline; if further work is planned, the modal cluster (Share/Lock/OTP/Reassign) could be split into its own file — cosmetic only.
TasksPanel.jsx dropped from 3874 → 1845 lines (52% reduction). Clean extraction; no unused imports observed in webpack build.

removeTask still deletes without confirm dialog — matches pre-refactor behavior but is a UX gap for a destructive action. Consider wrapping with confirmDialog like dissolveGroup does (product decision, not a refactor bug).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on exercised flows (9/9 verifications passed, zero errors)
